mkhomedir_helper_path.description: Path to the oddjob-mkhomedir helper executable. Ensure this matches the installed binary location.

max_threads.description: Maximum number of worker threads to handle concurrent service requests. Increase for high-load systems.

service_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for a service to complete before timing out. Prevents hung services from blocking indefinitely.

services.description: List of custom oddjob services to define. Each entry declares a service name, path, and access controls.
